result.summary: Changes the options parameter in estimatesmartfee from OBJ to OBJ_NAMED_PARAMS, allowing inner options such as fee_rate_estimator and verbosity to be supplied as top-level named arguments. Adjusts RPC help text formatting so OBJ_NAMED_PARAMS is documented as a closed key-value dictionary, and adds a shared functional test helper for option validation.
result.problem: estimatesmartfee was the only RPC method with an options object that did not allow those options to be passed directly as top-level named arguments, making its interface inconsistent with other RPCs and inconvenient for RPC and CLI callers.
evidence: Author notes in PR description: "estimatesmartfee is the only RPC that rejects named arguments for options, which seems confusing and not user friendly."
result.changed_since_previous: The implementation diff is now available, showing changes beyond the core RPC modification: adding client.cpp conversion support for the verbosity option, updating RPC help formatting for OBJ_NAMED_PARAMS, and introducing the assert_rpc_options_validation test helper.
result.card: Switches the estimatesmartfee RPC to use OBJ_NAMED_PARAMS so callers can pass options directly as top-level named arguments. estimatesmartfee was the only RPC with an options dictionary that rejected named parameter passing, creating an inconsistent interface. The PR also improves RPC help rendering for closed option dictionaries and adds option-validation test helpers.

risk.why: A mistake in RPC argument parsing or conversion tables could break fee estimation calls for external RPC clients or CLI users.
